notablePrerequisites: Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Composite Golem by paying {6}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Composite Golem spell.
Resolve the copy of the Composite Golem spell, creating a token copy of Composite Golem.
Activate the token Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
The token Composite Golem dies, triggering Drafna, untapping Drafna.
Repeat from step 2.
